descriptors.definition: Exempt incomes under section 11 and its schedules are completely excluded from the computation of total income. In contrast, deductions under Chapter VIII are first included in the gross total income and subsequently deducted.
inclusion: Incomes specified under Schedules II to VI
Total income of specified persons under Schedule VII
exclusion: Incomes subject to deductions under Chapter VIII prior to final total income computation
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes complete exclusion from total income via exemptions versus subsequent subtraction through Chapter VIII deductions

descriptors.definition: Agricultural income is entirely excluded from central income-tax due to constitutional limitations on central taxing powers. The statutory definition encompasses rent or revenue from Indian agricultural land, income derived from agricultural operations and processing, and income from specific rural farm buildings.
inclusion: Rent or revenue derived from land situated in India and used for agricultural purposes
Income derived from agricultural operations and standard market-preparation processes
Income from farm buildings occupied by cultivators or receivers of rent under specified conditions
exclusion: Income from land not used for agricultural purposes
Income from buildings located in specified urban areas failing rural land revenue criteria
nearby_distinctions: Differentiates between direct cultivation returns, land rents, and associated farm building usage versus non-agricultural commercial land uses

descriptors.definition: Expenditures incurred in relation to income that does not form part of total income are disallowed as deductions. This disallowance applies regardless of whether the corresponding exempt income was actually accrued, arisen, or received during the tax year.
inclusion: Direct expenditure relating to exempt income
Indirect expenditure computed as a percentage of investment balances under prescribed rules
exclusion: Expenditures incurred solely in relation to taxable income streams
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between deductible business expenses tied to taxable revenues and statutory disallowances mandated for expenses linked to tax-free receipts
